title: Hotel de Russie vs Hotel de la Ville: Rocco Forte Sisters (2026) | Suites With Keith
description: Hotel de Russie vs Hotel de la Ville, the two Rocco Forte hotels in Rome, compared by a travel advisor who visited both in October 2026: courtyards, rooftop, rooms, spas, and which sister I prefer.

hero.alt: Hotel de Russie’s large courtyard, with white umbrellas over tables and salmon-pink walls with blue-gray shutters
Hotel de la Ville’s courtyard, with red and white striped umbrellas and salmon-pink walls with green shutters

sub: Rocco Forte has two hotels in Rome, a few minutes apart near the Spanish Steps. Same family, different strengths. Here is the one I would book, and when the other makes sense.

choose.lead: I loved it. The large courtyard is the star, the renovated rooms have the cutest lemon and orange ceilings, and the spa has an indoor pool. The stronger stay of the two sisters.
choose.alt: A Hotel de Russie room ceiling papered with oranges, pears and blossoms above olive curtains

choose.h3: If you want the Steps and a rooftop
choose.lead: A nice hotel right at the top of the Spanish Steps, in an 18th-century palazzo with colorful, very Roman interiors and Cielo, the rooftop bar and restaurant with views all over the city.
choose.alt: A Hotel de la Ville salon with yellow walls hung with engravings, teal damask curtains and a black and white marble floor

pitch: Work with me and you get Fora perks, plus someone who knows these hotels personally and personalizes your stay: I tell you which de Russie suite has the views, match you to the right room at either sister, and arrange your transfers and drivers. Same rate as booking direct.

band.h2: Same family, a few minutes apart. Which sister should you book?
paras: For me, Hotel de Russie. Its large courtyard, renovated rooms and spa with an indoor pool made it the stronger stay, and the courtyard is a big part of why. I loved it.
Hotel de la Ville was nice. Honestly, I don’t have a ton to say about it. Its best card is Cielo, the rooftop bar and restaurant with views all over the city, and its address at the top of the Steps.
If you have no strong pull either way, book the de Russie. If sunset drinks on a rooftop and the Spanish Steps at your door are the point of the trip, the de la Ville does that well.

guide.alt: The bar in Hotel de Russie’s courtyard, with arched blue shelves of bottles and a mosaic-fronted marble counter
paras: Both sisters have a courtyard. At Hotel de Russie, it is beautiful, large and really the star of the property. It’s where everyone gathers, with a bar, and it feels like an escape from the city around it.
At Hotel de la Ville, Mosaico, the main restaurant, opens onto the courtyard.

guide.alt: A renovated Hotel de Russie bedroom in soft green, with a striped headboard and floral cushions
paras: Hotel de Russie’s rooms have been renovated, and they have the cutest ceilings, each one lemon or orange themed. I saw a stunning suite with a terrace and fantastic views; ask me which one.

Hotel de la Ville has 104 rooms and suites in an 18th-century palazzo, some with terraces and city views. The interiors are colorful and very Roman: yellow walls, engravings, plaster reliefs and black and white floors.

guide.alt: The indoor pool in the Hotel de Russie spa, tiled in blue mosaic under a starry ceiling
paras: Hotel de Russie has a nice spa with an indoor pool, rare in the centro storico and a real draw after a day on foot.
Hotel de la Ville has a Sicilian-inspired spa. If a pool matters, the de Russie is the one.

guide.alt: A Hotel de la Ville bedroom with green velvet curtains, a yellow loveseat and a balcony looking out to umbrella pines
paras: The highlight at Hotel de la Ville is Cielo, the rooftop bar and restaurant across the top two floors, with views across Rome’s skyline. Add the Julep cocktail bar for an evening drink.

Both are busy outside. The de la Ville is at the top of the Spanish Steps, crowded from morning to night, and Hotel de Russie has the crowds between Popolo and the Steps. For a quiet street, the Eden is the one.

faq.q: Hotel de Russie or Hotel de la Ville?
faq.a: Hotel de Russie. They are sister Rocco Forte hotels a few minutes apart, and the de Russie’s large courtyard, renovated rooms and spa with an indoor pool made it the stronger stay for me. Pick Hotel de la Ville if a rooftop bar and the top of the Spanish Steps are what you want most.
Yes. Hotel de Russie and Hotel de la Ville are both Rocco Forte hotels, a few minutes apart near the Spanish Steps.
Hotel de la Ville: Cielo, across the top two floors, with views all over the city. At Hotel de Russie, the gathering place is the courtyard.
Hotel de Russie, in its spa. Hotel de la Ville has a Sicilian-inspired spa.
Not on the street. Both put you in the crowds near the Spanish Steps. For quiet in the middle of Rome, I pick the Eden or the Corinthia.
